instruction: Swap the positions of Thunderbird and Chrome in your favorites dock, keeping Vim in the middle.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
